purpose: The visitors' open demo auction through judging: anyone may bid with PEAL-T from the demo faucet, using a guest account in the browser
terms: 50 fUSD for PEAL-T, limits 0.50 to 2.25 PEAL-T per fUSD in 8 steps, bond 1 PEAL-T, at most 32 bids, committee 2 of 3

freshGuestProof.what: A first-time visitor's path through the production build (vercel.json headers and rewrites, via npm run web:preview) in headless Chromium, desktop and phone: a guest account created in the page, funded, then straight to the bid page with no PEAL-T. The page registered the ML-DSA-87 key, opened one window for 3 transactions scoped to 3 contracts, and sent the faucet claim, approve and commitBid of a bid sealed in the browser. The results page shows it as the guest's, still sealed

funding.note: test funding only: 1.2 QOR from the deployer stands in for the dashboard faucet, which needs a signed-in visitor

freshGuestProof.bid: 5 fUSD at most 1.50 PEAL-T each: escrow 7.5 + bond 1 PEAL-T
